extra.message: course_shell_probe_634 builds a shell command by concatenating the unsanitized 'host' GET parameter directly into os.system('ping -c 1 ' + host). An attacker can inject shell metacharacters (e.g. `; rm -rf /` or `$(whoami)`) to execute arbitrary OS commands.

cwe: CWE-78: OS Command Injection

extra.message: course_xml_fold_616 parses the raw request body with an lxml XMLParser configured with load_dtd=True and resolve_entities=True (and network access not disabled), then feeds attacker-controlled XML directly into etree.fromstring(). This allows XML External Entity (XXE) attacks to read local files or perform SSRF via crafted DOCTYPE/ENTITY declarations.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: course_jinja_cast_586 concatenates the user-controlled 'fragment' GET parameter directly into a Jinja2 template string and renders it: Template('Result: ' + fragment).render(). This is a classic Server-Side Template Injection allowing arbitrary Jinja2 expression evaluation and remote code execution (e.g. fragment={{ self.__init__.__globals__.__builtins__ }}).

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code (Code Injection)

extra.message: course_vault_stash_245 builds a filesystem path from the unsanitized 'ref' GET parameter (target = BASE_EXPORT_DIR / f"{ref}.json") and writes attacker-supplied content to it. A value like ref=../../../../tmp/evil allows writing files outside BASE_EXPORT_DIR. The endpoint also persists sensitive SSN/card data supplied via query parameters in plaintext.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory (Path Traversal)

extra.message: course_dock_shelf_593 builds a filesystem path directly from the unsanitized 'name' GET parameter (target = BASE_EXPORT_DIR / name) and writes the raw request body to it. A value like name=../../../../var/www/shell.py allows writing arbitrary files anywhere the process can reach, including outside BASE_EXPORT_DIR.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory (Path Traversal)

extra.message: course_return_lane_162 redirects to a 'lane' value taken directly from GET/POST parameters with no validation of scheme or host (return redirect(lane)). An attacker can craft a link to this endpoint that redirects victims to an arbitrary external site for phishing.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site (Open Redirect)

extra.message: course_origin_mirror_564 reflects the attacker-supplied Origin request header back in the Access-Control-Allow-Origin response header while also setting Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. extra.message: course_identity_ping_341 is the only handler in this module that does not call the internal-token gate (_wrk_gate) used by every sibling endpoint, so it is reachable by any unauthenticated client while the rest of the 'ops' surface is meant to require the internal token, indicating a missing authorization check.

extra.message: course_identity_hint_554 authorizes requests against a hardcoded dictionary of handle-to-PIN mappings ({'north': '4812', 'south': '5930'}) embedded in source code, with no rate limiting on guesses of the 4-digit verifier value.

extra.message: course_roster_fold_066 returns a hardcoded live-looking partner sync token ('tok_live_partner_sync') and what appears to be an SSN-formatted value ('739-44-1982') in its JSON response to any caller possessing the internal token, exposing sensitive secrets/PII.
